Global default; per-channel \"Upstream uses Responses API\" overrides. When off, upstream still uses /v1/chat/completions.
Replace API keys / tokens in requests with *** before forwarding (sk-, ghp_, AKIA, AIza, Bearer …)

. any char
\d \w \s digit / word / whitespace
[abc] one of a b c
[^abc] not a b c
* + ? 0+ , 1+ , 0 or 1
{2,5} 2 to 5 times
^ $ start / end of text
(…) capture group
a|b a or b
\. literal dot (escape)

$1 $2 group 1 / 2
$0 whole match
(empty) delete the match
\$ literal dollar sign

1. Mask emails
 regex: [\w.]+@[\w.]+
 to: ***

2. Swap word order
 regex: (\w+) (\w+)
 to: $2 $1

3. Strip trailing spaces
 regex: [ \t]+$
 to: (empty)

4. Replace a term (case-insensitive, turn on ci)
 regex: chatgpt
 to: AI

5. Collapse blank lines
 regex: \n{3,}
 to: \n\n

• The model field and data: URLs are never touched.
• Outgoing rules apply to request text, incoming to response text.
• Streaming responses are matched per chunk, so patterns spanning chunks may not match.
• Rules take effect after the gateway restarts.

resources.string: This app is a management client. Run ai-gateway-AI in Termux, on this phone or on the LAN, then connect with its address and webToken. If 2FA is enabled, add the second key / TOTP secret later in Connection settings.
Set webToken in the gateway config (or panel → Config). The management API requires it for remote access.
Web Token is required for remote management
Address must start with http:// or https://
Connection failed. Check the address, certificate and webToken.
Password for the admin API (config.webToken). Empty = management API disabled for remote clients.
After changing webToken, update the connection settings in this app as well. The gateway restarts immediately.
This instance token was updated. Your current connection uses the default instance, so it was left unchanged.
Connection URL switched to %1$s. If the certificate is from agw-tls, install its CA as a user certificate.
Run ai-gateway-AI on this phone (Node runtime)

Battery optimization is ON: the system may freeze the gateway in the background.

The gateway runs in a foreground service so Android keeps it alive. It does not auto-start after reboot. The bundled Node runtime is 18.20.4 (end-of-life upstream) and its prebuilt library is 4 KB page aligned, so devices with 16 KB memory pages are not supported.
